tailoring.headline: Business Analyst – SAP Commerce (Hybris) Specialist | 5+ yrs e-commerce delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, Backoffice and HAC customisations, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record of analysing production incidents, writing user stories, mapping processes and supporting international stakeholders in agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Analyst (SAP Commerce / Hybris) | Contract
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to join your team because of your innovative approach to digital commerce. With 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce (Hybris) experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and functional expertise that aligns perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: Techno-functional expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell I worked directly with business stakeholders, translating requirements into Backoffice and HAC customisations and delivering functional specifications.

bullets.label: Production issue resolution
bullets.text: I investigated and resolved critical production incidents, optimizing data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM to ensure uninterrupted commerce operations.

bullets.label: API & integration leadership
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST services and built end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris integrations, improving data consistency across global channels.
Led code reviews, mentored junior developers and drove CI/CD deployments on CCv2, ensuring high-quality releases in fast-paced agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your success.

tailoring.why_company: Your company’s focus on building a resilient, scalable SAP Commerce platform that serves a global B2B audience resonates with my experience delivering high-performance Hybris solutions for multinational manufacturers. I admire your commitment to continuous innovation and cross-functional collaboration, and I am eager to apply my techno-functional background to help accelerate your roadmap and enhance customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help you deliver a robust SAP Commerce solution that drives growth, leveraging my proven Hybris expertise and business-analysis skills.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) Business Analyst with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can help your team tackle production challenges and accelerate integration projects.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will streamline your Backoffice and HAC customisations, implement robust OCC APIs and optimise PIM-ERP data pipelines, drawing on my proven delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My hands-on experience with CI/CD on CCv2 will also accelerate release cycles.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Business Analyst (SAP Commerce / Hybris) – Contract
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) Business Analyst with 5+ years delivering end-to-end e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am impressed by your commitment to a resilient commerce platform and can immediately add value by optimising Backoffice/HAC customisations and strengthening PIM-ERP integrations. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.
